12	/-!
13	# Native presentations for split field classes
14	
15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
18	
19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
21	
22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
24	-/

41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
46	
47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
59	    apply Spec.map_injective
60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
61	    exact hw
62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
63	    { __ := psi.hom
64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
67	  ext : 1
68	  exact hmap.symm
69	
70	/-- Complete the native presentation attached to an actual lambda-tied datum.
71	
72	The input is exactly the remaining family-level H¹ obligation.  The degree law follows from the
73	two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
74	arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
75	all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
76	noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
77	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
78	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
79	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
80	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
81	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
82	    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
83	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
84	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
85	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
86	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class
87	      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres

91

93	H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
94	Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
95	cocycle datum. -/
96	theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
97	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
98	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
99	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
100	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
101	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
102	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
103	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
104	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
105	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
106	  exact ⟨P.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness hpi
107	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)⟩
108	
109	/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.
110	
111	Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
112	preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
113	-/
114	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
115	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
116	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
117	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
118	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
119	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
120	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
121	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
122	  intro A _ _ t
123	  obtain ⟨e, ht⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k) K A t
124	  rw [ht]
125	  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
126	    (C := C) hpi e lam.1 rfl hsplit
127	
128	end

12	
13	Two converse-direction bricks for the rank-one openness lane.
14	
15	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp` (D0) — **testPoint naturality
16	  in the slice**: for `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t` of `T'.left`, the
17	  naturality square of the residue-field bridge (`Over.testPoint_comp_left`) is promoted
18	  to an equation of slice morphisms through a `k`-algebra map of the two residue fields.
19	  The algebra-map upgrade of `testPointFieldMap` is not done by hand: it is delegated to
20	  `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`, whose `Spec.preimage` performs it once.
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness` (D1) — **the field
23	  converse of the presentation contract**: a `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a
24	  genus-degree class over a field `K` yields `IsSplitWitness` for that class.  The
25	  splitting field is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the presentation's
26	  étale cover (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`); the presenting
27	  equation is the plus-class field collapse (`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom`) read
28	  through `P.datum_class`; the witness divisor comes from the presentation's own
29	  `H¹`-vanishing through the datum dictionary
30	  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton`).
31	
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` — membership of a field
33	  class in `PicRankOneOpen` implies `IsSplitWitness`, by testing with the identity.
34	  Together with the landed `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` this is the fibrewise
35	  characterization of the rank-one locus at fields.

70	underlying map of the connecting morphism is `Spec` of `Over.testPointFieldMap f t`, and
71	its `k`-algebra structure is recovered by `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`
72	rather than assembled by hand. -/
73	theorem Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp
74	    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
75	    ∃ φ : Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) →ₐ[k]
76	        Over.testPointField (T := T') t,
77	      Over.testPoint t ≫ f
78	        = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t) := by
79	  have hw : Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
80	        ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
81	      = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom := by
82	    calc Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
83	          ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
84	        = Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
85	            ≫ ((Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left ≫ T.hom) := by
86	          rw [Over.w (Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t))]
87	      _ = ((Over.testPoint t).left ≫ f.left) ≫ T.hom := by
88	          rw [← Category.assoc, ← Over.testPoint_comp_left f t]
89	      _ = (Over.testPoint t).left ≫ T'.hom := by
90	          rw [Category.assoc, Over.w f]
91	      _ = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom :=
92	          Over.w (Over.testPoint t)

94	    (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))
95	    (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)
96	    (Over.homMk (Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)) hw)
97	  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
98	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext

104	/-- Triviality of a module is preserved by any coefficient extension: a tensor product
105	with a subsingleton factor is a subsingleton. -/
106	private theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
107	    {R X Y : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X]
108	    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] (h : Subsingleton X) :
109	    Subsingleton (X ⊗[R] Y) := by
110	  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
111	  induction z with
112	  | zero => rfl
113	  | tmul x y => rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]

127	`h1_vanishing` field survives the coefficient extension to `L` (`0 ⊗ = 0`), which is
128	exactly the datum dictionary's condition at `L`. -/
129	theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness
130	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
131	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
132	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
133	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
134	    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
135	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hKL, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
136	    P.cover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
137	  letI := hLf
138	  letI := hKL
139	  letI := hLfin
140	  letI := hLsep
141	  letI hkL : Algebra k L := ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
142	  haveI htowkKL : IsScalarTower k K L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
143	  letI hBL : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
144	  haveI htowKBL : IsScalarTower K P.cover.Carrier L :=
145	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
146	  haveI htowkBL : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
147	    change algebraMap k L x = ψ (algebraMap k P.cover.Carrier x)
148	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K P.cover.Carrier, ψ.commutes,
149	      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L]
150	  have hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K lam.1)
151	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
152	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
153	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
154	    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom C P.representative ψ,

158	      ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)

160	    (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mpr hsub

11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
12	
13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
17	
18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
23	-/

41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
42	
43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
46	def PicRankOneOpen :
47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
55	      apply Subtype.ext
56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
57	    rw [e]
58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

60	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
61	
62	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
63	
64	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
65	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
66	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
67	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
69	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
70	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
71	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
72	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi

113

115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the

119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=

125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

131	
132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
133	
134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
138	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
142	  W : X.Opens
143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶

145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
150	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w

161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :

163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
168	      φ.app S) D.sq
169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
171	  · intro v w hvw
172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
174	
175	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
176	
177	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
179	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
180	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
181	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
182	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
183	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
184	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
185	  intro X g
186	  let d := D X g
187	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩

190	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
191	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
192	  h
193

195	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
196	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
197	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
198	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
200	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
201	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
202	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
203	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
204	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
205	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
206	  h.property g fst snd hpb

208	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
209	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
210	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
211	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
212	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
213	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h

216	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
217	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
218	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
219	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
220	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h

223	
224	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
225	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
226	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
227	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
228	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

233	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
234	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
235	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

238	def rankOneAbelAff :
239	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
240	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=

244	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :

246	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
247	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
248	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
249

251	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
252	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
253	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=

8	/-!
9	# CHART-U(b) AT A GENERAL TEST: `isOpen_chartLocus`, and the advertised lemma that did not exist
10	
11	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean` proves `isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` over an
12	**affine** test, and its docstring says the general-test statement "follows from this one by the
13	affine-piece locality of the (b-amendment)'s transport (iii) … needs no new mathematics".  That
14	claim is right, and this file discharges it — but two of its ingredients were not where the tree
15	said they were.
16	
17	## The advertised lemma that was absent
18	
19	`Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`'s header says chart-independence of the residue field is free
20	"and the chart comparison becomes a lemma (`testPointField_affineOpen_iso`) instead of a side
21	condition.  That is the whole reason this file is short."  **No declaration of that name exists
22	anywhere in the workspace** — the only occurrence was that sentence (cf. I-0624:
23	advertised-but-absent).  Since it is cited as the reason a side condition is unnecessary, it is
24	load-bearing prose, so it is supplied here as `testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso`.
25	
26	It is genuinely cheap, but not for the reason the header gives: what makes it work is that
27	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U` is an **open immersion** on carriers
28	(`IsAffineOpen.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec`), and mathlib already knows the residue-field map of an
29	open immersion is an isomorphism
30	(`Scheme.instIsIsoCommRingCatResidueFieldMapOfIsOpenImmersion`).  So the comparison is an
31	iso for a structural reason, not by a computation with `Spec.residueFieldIso`.
32	
33	## Locality: what "open in every affine piece" needs
34	
35	`isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open`-style bookkeeping is not quite enough, because the locus over the
36	piece is a subset of a *different* space (`Spec Γ(T.left, U)`, not `T.left`).  The bridge is that
37	`fromSpecAffine`'s carrier map is an open immersion with range `U`, so the image of the piece's
38	locus is the intersection of `chartLocus` with `U` — that is what
39	`chartLocus_inter_affineOpen_eq_image` records, and the openness statement then follows from
40	openness of an open immersion's image.
41	
42	## Main declarations
43	
44	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso` — **the absent advertised lemma**:
45	  the residue-field comparison along an affine-open test object is an isomorphism.
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isSplitWitness_fromSpecAffine_iff` — hence the split-witness predicate
47	  at a point of an affine piece agrees with the one at its image in `T`; this is transport (i)'s
48	  hypothesis `hinv` **discharged** for the affine-piece maps (both directions), rather than
49	  assumed.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal` — **CHART-U(b) at a general test**: if
51	  `chartLocus` is open over each affine-open test object, it is open over `T`.
52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_presentations` — the same fed with the per-piece
53	  presentation hypotheses, i.e. the general-test keystone of dat-b row B-4 modulo exactly the
54	  per-piece shifted-datum presentations and nothing else.
55	-/

73	LOCAL instance, so every file stating something about `overSpec k Γ(T.left, U)` must re-open it. -/
74	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

77	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]

85	/-! ## The absent advertised lemma -/
86	
87	/-- **The residue-field comparison along an affine-open test object is an isomorphism** — the
88	lemma `Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`'s header advertises as `testPointField_affineOpen_iso`
89	and which does not exist under that (or any) name.
90	
91	For `U` an affine open of `T.left` and `t` a point of `Spec Γ(T.left, U)`, the induced extension
92	`κ(fromSpecAffine T U (t)) → κ(t)` is invertible.
93	
94	The reason is structural rather than computational: `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec` is an open immersion,
95	and the residue-field map of an open immersion is an iso in mathlib already. -/
96	instance testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
97	    (U : T.left.affineOpens) (t : (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)).left) :
98	    IsIso (testPointFieldMap (fromSpecAffine T U) t) := by
99	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (fromSpecAffine T U).left := U.2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec
100	  exact Scheme.instIsIsoCommRingCatResidueFieldMapOfIsOpenImmersion
101	    (fromSpecAffine T U).left t
102	
103	end Over
104	
105	/-! ## Transport (i) for the affine-piece maps, both directions -/
106	
107	variable (C) in
108	/-- **The residue-field-iso invariance of the split-witness predicate** — the obligation the
109	general-test assembly actually rests on, named rather than hidden.
110	
111	`mem_chartLocus_of_mem_chartLocus_comp` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:360`) says transport (i) "proves
112	nothing on its own — it is an interface, and its proof is `hinv`", and that the tree's landed
113	invariance discharges `hinv` for *separable* residue-field extensions.  For an affine-open test
114	object the extension is an **isomorphism** (`Over.testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso` — hence in
115	particular separable), so morally transport (i) is free here.
116	
117	**But the landed invariance is about `HasWitnessH1Vanishing`, not about `IsSplitWitness`**, and no
118	declaration in the tree transports `IsSplitWitness` along a field isomorphism: measured, the only
119	mentions of `IsSplitWitness` invariance are two docstring sentences.  So the affine-piece case of
120	transport (i) needs *one* lemma the tree does not have, which is this predicate.  That is a
121	correction to `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s claim that the general-test statement "needs no new
122	mathematics": it needs exactly this, and nothing else.

# The fibrewise split-witness characterization of the public rank-one locus

Two consumer packagings of the landed rank-one openness bricks.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_picRankOneOpen_iff_isSplitWitness` — the **fibrewise
  characterization at a field**: for a field base `K/k`, membership of a genus-degree class in
  the public rank-one locus `PicRankOneOpen` is equivalent to the class being a split witness.
  This simply pairs the two landed directions
  `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` (from `Pic0RankOneNativePresentationSplit`) and
  `isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` (from `Pic0RankOneSplitOfPresentation`).

* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_testPoint_of_mem` — the **pointwise consequence at an
  arbitrary test**: a class living in the rank-one locus over any test `T` has a split-witness
  fibre at every point `t : T.left`.  The membership is pulled back along the affine field
  point `Over.testPoint t` by `picRankOneOpen_map_mem`, landing at the field
  `Over.testPointField t`, and the field converse then applies.  The underlying picard class
  of the pulled-back layer element is `picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam.1` by definition of
  `picDegLayerFunctor`'s `map`.
-/

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- **The fibrewise split-witness characterization of `PicRankOneOpen` at a field.**

For a field base `K/k`, a genus-degree Picard class `lam` over `overSpec k K` belongs to the
public rank-one locus if and only if it is a split witness.  This is the conjunction of the two
landed directions: `isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` (membership tested with the
identity produces a presentation, hence a split witness) and
`mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` (a split field class receives the required native
presentation on every affine pullback, using `hpi`). -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff_isSplitWitness
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) ↔ IsSplitWitness C lam.1 :=
  ⟨fun h => isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field pi h,
   fun hsplit => mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness pi hpi lam hsplit⟩

/-- **Every point of a rank-one-open class has a split-witness fibre.**

For an arbitrary test `T` and a class `lam` of the degree-`genus C` layer that lies in the public
rank-one locus over `T`, the fibre of `lam` at any point `t : T.left` — read at the residue field
`Over.testPointField t` through the affine field point `Over.testPoint t` — is a split witness.

The membership is stable under pullback (`picRankOneOpen_map_mem`) along `(Over.testPoint t).op`,
which lands at the field base `overSpec k (Over.testPointField t)`; the field converse
`isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` then applies.  The underlying picard class of the
pulled-back layer element is `picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam.1` by definition of
`picDegLayerFunctor`'s `map`, so no explicit rewrite is needed. -/
theorem isSplitWitness_testPoint_of_mem
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj (op T)}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op T))
    (t : T.left) :
    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam.1) :=
  isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field pi
    (picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.testPoint t).op h)

end
